name: Daratumumab + Bortezomib + Lenalidomide + Dexamethasone (Dara-VRd)

biomarkers.note: Dara-VRd is a four-drug antibody/proteasome-inhibitor/IMiD regimen and is not biomarker-restricted for eligibility. Cytogenetic risk (FISH for t(4;14), t(14;16), t(14;20), del(17p)/TP53, gain/amp 1q) informs risk stratification (R-ISS/R2-ISS), not access to the regimen. Type and screen before starting daratumumab (serologic interference). Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Multiple Myeloma, v5.2026.

treatmentSetting: primary induction (and consolidation) therapy for newly diagnosed, transplant-eligible (HCT-candidate) multiple myeloma
lineOfTherapy: first-line (primary) therapy for newly diagnosed transplant-eligible multiple myeloma (patients <80 years who are not frail); Preferred, category 1 (PERSEUS, GRIFFIN)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: newly diagnosed symptomatic multiple myeloma, transplant-eligible / HCT candidate, generally <80 years and not frail
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v5.2026, MYEL-G (Primary Therapy for HCT Candidates): Daratumumab/Bortezomib/Lenalidomide/Dexamethasone, Preferred, category 1

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: type and screen before first daratumumab dose (interferes with indirect antiglobulin testing)
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v5.2026, MS (perform type and screen before using daratumumab or isatuximab-irfc)

drugs.name: Daratumumab

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 74, Table 74.6 (Common Treatment Regimens in Multiple Myeloma), p.1520, daratumumab dosing line 286349 (Daratumumab 1,800 mg SC (or 16 mg/kg IV) weekly x 8 weeks, then every 2 weeks for 4 months, then once monthly)

drugs.notes: DOSE sourced: DeVita 12th ed., Table 74.6, p.1520 (line 286349): daratumumab 1,800 mg SC (or 16 mg/kg IV). The daratumumab administration cadence (weekly induction, then every 2 weeks, then monthly) is the printed anti-CD38 schedule; days [1, 8, 15] represent weekly dosing on the modeled cycle. SCHEDULE CAVEAT: DeVita Table 74.6 does not print Dara-VRd as a single regimen row, so the precise per-cycle mapping of daratumumab within the pivotal Dara-VRd studies (PERSEUS, GRIFFIN) is captured in evidence.divergence for clinical verification; the DOSE itself is sourced. Give infusion/injection-reaction premedication; perform type and screen before the first dose.

drugs.name: Bortezomib

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 74, Table 74.6, p.1520, VRd entry, line 286317 (Bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 SC on days 1, 8, and 15)

drugs.notes: DOSE sourced: DeVita 12th ed., Table 74.6, p.1520 (line 286317), VRd backbone: bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 SC once weekly on days 1, 8, 15. SCHEDULE CAVEAT: the pivotal Dara-VRd studies used a bortezomib cadence tied to a 28-day induction cycle that is not reproduced as a single printed Dara-VRd row; recorded in evidence.divergence for verification. SC route reduces peripheral neuropathy; give VZV antiviral prophylaxis.

drugs.name: Lenalidomide

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 74, Table 74.6, p.1520, VRd entry, line 286318 (Lenalidomide 25 mg PO on days 1-14)

drugs.notes: DOSE sourced: DeVita 12th ed., Table 74.6, p.1520 (line 286318), VRd backbone: lenalidomide 25 mg PO days 1 to 14. SCHEDULE CAVEAT (days 1 to 14 vs days 1 to 21 in a 28-day Dara-VRd cycle) recorded in evidence.divergence. Requires VTE thromboprophylaxis and REMS-program dispensing (teratogen).

drugs.name: Dexamethasone

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: Chapter 74, Table 74.6, p.1520, VRd entry, line 286319 (Dexamethasone 20 mg on day of and day after bortezomib, or 40 mg on days 1, 8, 15, and 22)

drugs.notes: DOSE sourced: DeVita 12th ed., Table 74.6, p.1520 (line 286319), VRd backbone: dexamethasone 40 mg weekly (source also lists 20 mg on the day of and the day after bortezomib). Modeled as 40 mg on the in-cycle bortezomib days; also serves as daratumumab infusion premedication. Dose taken exactly as the source prints it.

premedications.name: Daratumumab infusion/injection-reaction prophylaxis
premedications.notes: corticosteroid (the regimen dexamethasone serves this role), antihistamine and antipyretic before daratumumab.

supportiveCare: Daratumumab: infusion/injection-reaction monitoring; type and screen before first dose; VZV and Pneumocystis prophylaxis per practice.
Bortezomib: peripheral neuropathy assessment each visit (reduce/hold for grade 2 or higher); VZV antiviral prophylaxis.
Lenalidomide: VTE thromboprophylaxis and REMS-program dispensing (teratogen); adjust for renal impairment.
Antiemetics: low to moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier.

monitoring: CBC with differential and platelets before each cycle
glucose and blood pressure (dexamethasone); infection surveillance (anti-CD38 antibody)

doseModificationRules.text: Reduce dose or change schedule for grade 2 or higher bortezomib peripheral neuropathy per labeling; clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Chapter 74 (Plasma Cell Neoplasms), Table 74.6, p.1520: VRd backbone (lines 286317 to 286319) and daratumumab dosing (line 286349)

guideline.locator: MYEL-G (Primary Therapy for HCT Candidates): Daratumumab/Bortezomib/Lenalidomide/Dexamethasone, Preferred, category 1; MS narrative supporting Dara-VRd (PERSEUS, GRIFFIN)

sources.name: DeVita 12th ed. (core)
sources.value: No single Dara-VRd row; doses assembled from the VRd row (bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 SC days 1,8,15; lenalidomide 25 mg days 1-14; dexamethasone 40 mg weekly; 21-day cycle) plus the Table 74.6 daratumumab dosing (1,800 mg SC or 16 mg/kg IV, weekly then q2wk then monthly)

sources.name: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) Multiple Myeloma
sources.value: Dara-VRd Preferred category 1 for HCT candidates; pivotal PERSEUS/GRIFFIN studies used a 28-day induction cycle with a distinct bortezomib cadence and lenalidomide days 1-21, followed by autologous HCT, consolidation and daratumumab/lenalidomide maintenance

divergence.note: Every DOSE is sourced to DeVita Table 74.6, but the integrated Dara-VRd per-cycle schedule and cycle length (28-day induction, bortezomib cadence, lenalidomide days 1-21, induction/consolidation/maintenance phasing) are NOT printed as a single source row. The exact schedule must be verified against the pivotal-trial protocol before this draft can advance beyond DRAFT.

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for Dara-VRd (daratumumab + bortezomib + lenalidomide + dexamethasone) in newly diagnosed transplant-eligible multiple myeloma (#82). Every DOSE is sourced to DeVita 12th ed., Chapter 74, Table 74.6 (p.1520): the VRd backbone (bortezomib 1.3 mg/m2 SC days 1,8,15 line 286317; lenalidomide 25 mg PO days 1-14 line 286318; dexamethasone 40 mg weekly line 286319) plus daratumumab 1,800 mg SC or 16 mg/kg IV (line 286349). Preferred, category 1 status for HCT candidates is sourced to Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Multiple Myeloma v5.2026, MYEL-G (PERSEUS, GRIFFIN). Because Table 74.6 does not print Dara-VRd as a single regimen row, the integrated per-cycle schedule and cycle length (the pivotal trials used a 28-day induction cycle with a distinct bortezomib cadence and lenalidomide days 1-21, then autologous HCT, consolidation and daratumumab/lenalidomide maintenance) are recorded in evidence.divergence (clinical-review-required) rather than invented; the modeled cycle uses the sourced VRd backbone schedule. No dose field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
